author: Richieroo14
body: Hello.  This michaelrocks1214 and I need to explain something that happened a while back, that needs to be noticed.  I admit that it was me who went on to my brother's account (Richieroo14)  and was saying things that should not been said aloud where lots can see.  I don't recall what it was, nor when.  But I DO remember that my brother was not at fault for this.  Now that I realize what has been done I realize it upset my brother, and since it is near the Holidays I thought i'd surprise him with bringing him back to his favorite Minecraft server.  If needed, you can ban my profile, and unban his.  Thank you to whoever is reading this,  I hope you can understand the reason I am taking your time to read my reason for what exactly went down.  Email this to the response to richieroo14@gmail.com please.  I'd appreciate it if you responded to this as soon as possible.  I don't think my poor brother deserves to be banned for my flaw.  Have a nice Day/Evening/Night.
